A1-REP: Type_Manif (#codeType, libType) ; Manifestation (#codeManif, nomManif, dateOuv, dateFer, #codeType) ; Halle (#codeHalle, libHalle, nbStandsMax) ; Stand (#codeStand, designation, superficie, etat, #codeHalle) ; Client (#codeCl, nomCl, telCl, emailCl, pays) ; Location (#codeManif#, #codeStand#, dateLoc, prix, #codeCl) ; Evaluation (#codeEval, dateEval, noteAccueil, noteConfort, noteSignal, noteLogistique, #codeManif)
A3-Q2: SELECT codeManif, nomManif, dateOuv FROM Manifestation WHERE DATEDIFF(dateFer, dateOuv) <= 4;
A3-Q3: UPDATE Location SET prix=prix*0.85 WHERE codeManif='M0001';
A3-Q4: SELECT DISTINCT nomCl, telCl, emailCl FROM Client INNER JOIN Location ON Client.codeCl = Location.codeCl;
A3-Q5: SELECT codeStand, designation, superficie FROM Stand INNER JOIN Halle ON Stand.codeHalle = Halle.codeHalle WHERE libHalle = 'Halle A' AND etat = 'L' ORDER BY superficie DESC;
A3-Q6: SELECT T.codeType, T.libType, COUNT(M.codeManif) FROM Type_Manif T LEFT JOIN Manifestation M ON T.codeType = M.codeType GROUP BY T.codeType, T.libType;
A3-Q7: SELECT Manifestation.codeManif, nomManif, SUM(prix) FROM Manifestation INNER JOIN Location ON Manifestation.codeManif = Location.codeManif GROUP BY Manifestation.codeManif, nomManif HAVING SUM(prix) > 10000;
A3-Q8: SELECT designation FROM Stand WHERE codeStand NOT IN (SELECT codeStand FROM Location WHERE dateLoc BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31');
A3-Q9: SELECT Stand.codeStand, designation, superficie FROM Stand INNER JOIN Location ON Stand.codeStand = Location.codeStand WHERE prix IN (SELECT MAX(prix) FROM Location);
A4-Q1: Pays(#codePays, libPays) ; Client(#codeCl, nomCl, telCl, emailCl, #codePays)
A4-Q2B: Service(#codeSer, libSer) ; Evaluation(#codeEval, dateEval, #codeManif) ; Note_Service(#codeEval, #codeSer, note, commentaire) avec codeEval# et codeSer# clés étrangères
